description: This file defines various classes of grains used for testing log consistency providers in an Orleans project. It includes configurations for different storage providers and log consistency providers, as well as custom storage interface implementations for some grains.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedStateStorage
classes.description: A grain class using Azure storage and a log consistency provider for shared state storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedLogStorage
classes.description: A grain class using Azure storage and a log consistency provider for shared log storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainDefaultStorage
classes.description: A grain class using default storage provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainMemoryStorage
classes.description: A grain class utilizing MemoryStore as storage, leveraging GSI grain.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStorage
classes.description: A grain class implementing a custom storage interface with explicit storage logic.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStoragePrimaryCluster
classes.description: A grain implementing custom storage with access restricted to the primary cluster, simulating async operations and state management.

methods.name: GetStorageGrain
methods.description: Retrieves the grain used as storage for this custom storage implementation.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Applies a list of updates to the storage, checking for version consistency.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Reads the grain state from storage, returning the current version and state object.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Simulates an asynchronous activation process, with a delay to avoid deadlocks.
